## Documenting the metadata format

This entity is real. The blocks below are content and must not bind.

```markdown
<!-- mex:entity
id: mx_01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV
type: decision
status: promoted
revision: 9
-->
## Not a real heading

Not a real body.
```

A fence may also contain frontmatter delimiters:

```yaml
---
name: not-frontmatter
---
```

~~~
## Not a heading either
### Nor this
~~~

That is all.
